arguments.text: GOAL fastest 10 km (out-and-back 1000 m legs, ~55 min). PACING: after the hard start settle to pod shaft ~150-160 W (pod CP 150 W, test may be 10-25% off); keep pod reserve above ~40% until 2.5 km left, then spend it; finish sprint ~500 m out. CHECK CP early: HR should level off at a steady effort below CP and climb above it. WATCH FOR: weed (boat power per pod watt drops mid-leg, HR unchanged) -> clear_rudder then check recovery; pod drift (pod power moves but HR and boat-model power do not) -> set pod_gain; radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell distance_left. Use notes to remember baselines.

NATURAL EXPERIMENT: leave them at ~164 W to ~7 min and measure HR trend 180-420 s; HR flat => CP likely >=160 (test low); HR still climbing => CP below 164, ease to ~150.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: From race_s ~540 pod power fell 155->125 W on the same southbound leg while boat-model power (104 W), GPS speed (3.12) and HR (167) stayed flat: pod reading drifting low. Gain ~0.85 at 650, ~0.81 at 680.

arguments.name: boat_vs_pod_share
arguments.evidence: boat-model power / pod power in clean pre-drift windows 180-600 s (hull fit 0.70). Test ratio was 0.627 so boat-model reserve reads too low.

arguments.name: pod_gain_live
arguments.description: pod raw reading vs boat-model power, scaled by the pre-drift share 0.67: ~1.0 when the pod reads true; noisy at turns

arguments.message: boat-model power under 92 W for a minute: paddler fading or drag up

arguments.text: Hold this effort exactly. It is sustainable. Steady rhythm.

GOAL fastest 10 km (1000 m out-and-back legs). POD DRIFTS LOW from race_s ~540 (reading falls while boat power, GPS, HR flat): do NOT trust shaft_power_w alone; judge effort by boat-model power (~104 W = ~155 W true at share 0.67), HR, and pod_gain_live (my metric; ~1 = pod true). Re-set pod_gain belief when pod_gain_live moves. CP pod ~155 (148-165) from HR; boat-model reserve reads too low (race share 0.67-0.70 vs test 0.627), ignore it. PACING: hold ~155-158 W true (boat ~104-106 W, HR ~167 steady) until 2.5 km left, then lift; finish sprint ~500 m out. Paddler says cooked at 8 min but numbers say fine: reassure. WATCH: weed (boat power drops while pod and HR flat -> clear_rudder), radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell.

11.3 min (race_s 680): POD DRIFT found: pod 155->125 W since ~540 with boat power 104, GPS 3.12, HR 167 flat. Set pod_gain 0.83 since 640, CP pod 155 (HR evidence). Easing piece ends 689; cued HOLD at ~155 W true. Next: check post-piece effort and pod_gain_live at ~13 min.
